name: @visuelconcept-winccoa/wui-tutorials
description: Tutorials for the operators: the guide that plays the modules' tutorials (tutorial/<id>.json, collected by wui-toolkit 0.30.0 or later into wui-tutorials.json) over the site — Sigma, a mascot, says each step, lights up its target and waits for the operator to do it: open a page, a menu entry, click, type; a hint when it is slow to come. The tutorials page (/tutorials) lists them with the roles they are for (hidden from a user who holds none, through Application Security), the badges earned, and starts one; a tutorial resumes after a reload. The guide is on every page through the module's shell boot script.
